annotations.title: Set a page aside from the search worklist, or put it back

description: Takes ONE page off the search opportunities list from read-search-opportunities, or puts it back with aside=false. Send `post_id`, or `url` for a row with no post behind it. This is a different list from set-aside-page: that one stops a page being graded for AI, and this one stops it being offered as a search opportunity. Neither changes the page. Use it when the owner has no interest in that page ranking, such as a legal page. ⛔ Not a way to clear the list: leaving out a page because the work is hard hides it from the owner. To drop a bad search rather than a page, use dismiss-search.

aside.description: True (the default) sets the page aside; false puts it back.

post_id.description: The page, from a read-search-opportunities row. Omit it for a row with no post.

url.description: The page’s address on this site, for a row with no post.

name: agentimus-set-aside-search-page

aside.description: Whether it is set aside NOW.

changed.description: Whether THIS call put it there.

postId.description: 0 when the page is held by its address.

url.description: The stored address, empty when the page is held by its post.
